subject.title: fix(agents): tighten lsSchema.limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the built-in `ls`, `read`, `find`, and `grep` count-like parameters reject fractional model arguments at schema validation, or preserve the current tolerant numeric contract and normalize them at execution?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically viable, but changing all four model-facing tool contracts can alter existing agent calls and the overlapping PRs propose different strictness levels, including minimums and runtime guards.

options.title: Adopt strict integer counts
options.body: Confirm integer-only schemas, keep timeout-like fields numeric, extract lightweight production schema artifacts, and require direct exact-head validation before merge.

options.title: Preserve tolerant normalization
options.body: Keep `Type.Number` and add explicit normalization and regression coverage if fractional model output should remain accepted rather than becoming a tool-call error.

recommendation.title: Adopt strict integer counts
recommendation.body: Confirm integer-only schemas, keep timeout-like fields numeric, extract lightweight production schema artifacts, and require direct exact-head validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest available owner-routing signal from the PR timeline for the agent-tool contract decision.
